drinks.name: Coffee and drinks
drinks.description: Coffee, tea and cold drinks, made as your order comes in.

bakery.name: Bakery
bakery.description: Baked here from 5am, until the trays are empty.

coffee-at-home.name: Coffee at home
coffee-at-home.description: Beans roasted three doors down, posted every weekday. Free postage on orders over £15.

products.name: Flat white
products.short: A double shot with silky milk, the one most people order.
description: Our house blend as a double ristretto, with milk steamed to a thin, glossy foam. Short enough to taste the coffee, long enough for the walk to work.

products.name: Latte
products.short: Long, milky and gentle, in a 12 oz cup.
description: A double shot in a tall cup of steamed milk. Ask for a third shot if the morning calls for it.

products.name: Espresso
products.short: A double shot, short and sweet.
description: Pulled for 28 seconds, with a thick crema. Have it at the counter while it is at its best.

products.name: Cold brew
products.short: Steeped for eighteen hours, poured over ice.
description: Coarse-ground coffee steeped in cold water overnight, then filtered twice. Smooth, low in acid and quietly strong.

products.name: Matcha latte
description: Japanese ceremonial-grade matcha, whisked with a little hot water and topped with steamed milk.

products.name: Cardamom bun
products.short: Our most asked-for bake, and the first to sell out.
description: A soft, buttery dough rolled with cardamom sugar, knotted by hand and baked until the edges caramelise. Warmed if you like.

products.name: Butter croissant
products.short: Laminated over three days, with French butter.
description: Folded and rested over three days for a shattering crust and a soft, honeycombed middle.

products.name: Country sourdough
products.short: A whole loaf, sliced if you ask.
description: Wheat and a little rye, fermented for thirty hours. It keeps for four days in a bread bag, and makes the best toast on day two.

products.name: Coffee and walnut cake
products.short: A slice of our coffee and walnut sponge.
description: Made with our espresso and toasted walnuts, with a coffee buttercream. Baked at the end of the week, and usually gone by Sunday.

products.name: Bircher oats
products.short: Soaked overnight, with fig, raspberries and honey.
description: Oats soaked overnight in apple juice and yoghurt, topped with fig, raspberries and local honey.

products.name: Avocado on sourdough
products.short: Chilli, lime and toasted seeds on our own sourdough.
description: Crushed avocado with chilli, lime and toasted seeds on a thick slice of our country sourdough.

products.name: Eggs your way
products.short: Scrambled, poached or fried, on toast.
description: Two free-range eggs from a farm outside Bath, cooked how you like them. Say which in the order note.

products.name: Corn and black bean salad
description: Charred sweetcorn and black beans with cherry tomatoes, red onion, lime and coriander.

products.name: Tomato and basil penne
description: Penne in a tomato sauce cooked down for three hours, finished with basil and parmesan.

products.name: House blend, 250 g
products.short: Our everyday coffee: sweet enough for milk, bright enough to drink black.
description: We built this blend for the café's flat whites and kept it because people kept asking for a bag. Brazilian Cerrado for body and chocolate, a washed Colombian from Huila for the apple brightness on top.
Brew 15 g of coffee to 250 g of water at 94 °C. The full method is in our pour-over guide.
Roasted on Tuesdays and Fridays and posted the same day when you order before 2pm. Free postage on orders over £15.

products.name: Roaster's pick, 250 g
products.short: A single-origin coffee we change with the harvest. This month: a washed Ethiopian.
description: A light roast for filter and pour-over, from a washing station in Guji we have bought from for three years.
Best as filter. As espresso it is bright and lively; with milk it gets lost.

products.name: House blend, 1 kg
products.short: Whole beans for the office, or a household that gets through a lot.
description: The house blend in a one-kilo bag of whole beans, with a valve so it keeps fresh for a month once open. Free postage.

products.name: Wildflower honey, 340 g
products.short: Raw honey from hives twenty miles south of the café.
description: Unheated and unblended, so it sets in the cooler months. Stand the jar in warm water to loosen it.

products.name: Glass pour-over set

specs.In the box: Glass dripper, 600 ml jug, 40 paper filters

products.short: The same dripper and jug we use behind the counter.
description: A glass dripper, a 600 ml jug and forty paper filters: all you need for the method in our pour-over guide.

house-blend: Exactly the flat white I get at the café, at home. Ground for my moka pot and it is spot on.
Arrives two days after roasting, every time. The bag fits through our letterbox.
Lovely chocolatey blend. I would like a bigger bag of ground coffee.
cardamom-bun: Worth ordering ahead: they were gone by ten on Saturday.
Soft, sticky and not too sweet. Ask for it warmed.
flat-white: The best on our side of the river.
roasters-pick: Bright and floral as a pour-over, like a cup of peach tea.
